messages:
maria: FYI customer reported weird behavior after upgrading to sdk v3.2. hedged requests + multi-region endpoints -> high tail latency and duplicate billing. attaching notes.
alex: oof. any repro steps from the customer?
maria: yes, they call our text.generate with region endpoints list: ["us-west1.redwood", "eu-west1.redwood"] and hedgedRequests: true. they set timeout=600ms. sometimes both requests succeed and they get charged twice.
sam: that sounds like hedged requests firing in parallel to different regions and both completing before cancelation. do we cancel the in-flight second request on success?
ingrid: our edge cancels when it receives the first completion, but sdk-level hedged callers may be opening separate independent requests that reach different edge nodes and both pass auth and execute. cancel signal might not reach compute in time.
maria: customer logs:

RequestId: r-9a12
Client: sdk-js/3.2
Configured endpoints: us-west1, eu-west1
hedged: true
timeout: 600ms
ResponseA: 200 (us-west1) 1400ms
ResponseB: 200 (eu-west1) 1420ms
Result: both responses completed, billing shows 2 x inference tokens

alex: the weird bit is both succeed after the client timeout? they set timeout 600ms but responses ~1400ms. sdk should give up at 600ms.
sam: I asked for their SDK config and they had `timeout` only on the request-level but hedged retries override the per-try deadline in current SDK impl. bug.
maria: reproduction steps (from customer):
1) set endpoints array to [us-west1, eu-west1]
2) enable hedgedRequests = true
3) set request timeout 600ms
4) send 100 short requests in burst
5) observe ~1-3% double-charge and higher tail latency
ingrid: possible causes:
- hedged requests use independent backoff windows, so if both are slow they both finish
- cancelation token not propagated reliably across grpc/http proxies
- routing fallback can flip region mid-flight if affinity header missing
alex: quick mitigation for customers: pin region (single endpoint) OR disable hedgedRequests OR set hedged maxInflight to 1. also advise increasing client timeout to > expected p95.
sam: we should ship an SDK patch: ensure per-request idempotency token applied to each logical request and server-side dedupe based on token for a short TTL. also make hedged requests attach a shared request-id and cancel second inflight attempts on first completion via a best-effort cancel endpoint.
ingrid: short-term infra mitigation: log when same request-id consumed twice across regions and emit metric `dup_charges.region_hop`.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0021 assigned to eng-ml. link: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-0021 :eyes:
alex: can we reproduce in staging? sam, can you add a small test harness to sdk-tests that spins up two regional proxies and simulates slow tails?
sam: yep, I'll add a test and a failing unit test for current behavior. plan:
- P0: add server-side dedupe by idempotency token (30s TTL)
- P0: patch sdk to send `x-redwood-request-id` on all hedged attempts and cancel best-effort when first completes
- P1: add telemetry metric and alert when dup_charges > 0.5% of requests in a minute
maria: customer-facing steps I'll send:
- disable hedgedRequests OR pin single region
- we'll run repro and update them in 24h
alex: also check billing pipeline to refund obvious duplicates where request id matches and timestamps within 5s.
sam: putting a patch in a draft PR now. will ping here when ready for review.
ingrid: adding INF/routing instrumentation ticket to see if affinity header lost when routing through edge LB.
maria: thanks all. keeping customer updated. :handshake:
alex: thumbs up, keep thread posted.
